def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the solid separator, which may be horizontal or vertical.
    candidates = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            candidates.append(("h", r, row[0]))
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            candidates.append(("v", c, grid[0][c]))

    orient, pos, _ = candidates[0]

    if orient == "v":
        a = [row[:pos] for row in grid]
        b = [row[pos + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        a = [row[:n] for row in a]
        b = [row[:n] for row in b]
    else:
        a = grid[:pos]
        b = grid[pos + 1:]
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[:n], b[:n]

    common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    background = next(iter(common))

    return [[3 if x == y else background for x, y in zip(ra, rb)]
            for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]

                   if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))

        a = [row[:n] for row in a]
        b = [row[:n] for row in b]

    shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    background = next(iter(shared))

    return [
        [3 if x == y else background for x, y in zip(ra, rb)]
        for ra, rb in zip(a, b)

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The uniform line separates two aligned binary panels.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w)
               if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    left = [row[:n] for row in left]
    right = [row[:n] for row in right]

    # Mark the right-panel foreground where the left panel is background.
    from collections import Counter
    left_bg = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    return [
        [3 if a == left_bg and b != right_bg else left_bg
         for a, b in zip(la, rb)]
        for la, rb in zip(left, right)
    ]
